title: Palindrome Removal
summary: Given an integer array, you can remove palindromic subarrays in one move.
statement: Given an integer array, you can remove palindromic subarrays in one move. Each move removes a palindromic segment, and the remaining elements shift to fill the gap. The task is to find the minimum number of moves required to remove all elements from the array.
constraints: In one move remove any nonempty contiguous palindromic subarray.
The remaining left and right parts join after removal.
Return the minimum moves needed to remove the whole nonempty array.
hints: Use interval DP for the minimum moves to erase each subarray.
Removing the left item alone costs one plus the rest; matching it with a later equal value can merge their removal.
Try every equal later position and combine the middle and suffix costs.
Every optimal first item is removed alone or together with some equal later item, so these transitions are exhaustive.

tests.explanation: Each unequal singleton must be removed separately.
Remove four, then the joined palindrome one-three-one, then five.
